[Turn 1] Julius Streicher was a prominent Nazi propagandist and publisher of the anti-Semitic newspaper "Der Stürmer" (The Attacker). He was a key figure in the Nazi propaganda machine and played a significant role in spreading anti-Semitic and racist ideologies during the Nazi regime in Germany. Streicher was arrested after the end of World War II and was executed in 1946.
